gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient must have histologically confirmed World Health Organization Grade IV glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: ONC201 is a orally active, small molecule DRD2 antagonist that kills cancer cells but not normal cells.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must be eligible for salvage surgical resection as deemed by the site Investigator.
Arm B will determine the radiographic efficacy of ONC201 in adult recurrent EGFR-low glioblastoma patients.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: intra-tumoral ONC201 concentrations in adult EGFR-low glioblastoma patients.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Arm A will explore the intra-tumoral ONC201 concentrations and pharmacodynamic activity in adult EGFR-low glioblastoma patients.

role_evidence.quote: All patients will be treated with oral ONC201 (625 mg) twice weekly, 2 consecutive days on and 5 days off per week schedule.

arms: Arm A: ONC201 with Surgical Resection in Glioblastoma

source_quote.quote: Patient must have all of the following in their most recently resected archival tumor tissue: (1) absence of EGFR gene amplification by FISH, (2) absence of EGFRvIII expression by RT-PCR, and (3) low EGFR expression by IHC.

flag.reason: EGFR-low selection is specific to ONC201 in this trial, but the record states no mechanistic link between EGFR and ONC201 (a DRD2 antagonist); could be judged a predictive candidate-matched selection.

source_quote.quote: Patient has a known histone H3 K27M mutation.
Patient has a known IDH1 (isocitrate dehydrogenase 1) or IDH2 mutations or 1p/19q co-deletion.
Patient has a known IDH1 (isocitrate dehydrogenase 1) or IDH2 mutations or 1p/19q co-deletion.

coder_notes: H3K27M, IDH and 1p/19q appear as exclusion criteria (known mutation excludes), coded as eligibility restrictions; H3K27M-mutant tumours (the population usually linked to ONC201) are excluded, so not candidate-matched. cns5 coded because IDH-mutant tumours are excluded (effectively IDH-wildtype required), though the inclusion text says only 'WHO Grade IV glioblastoma'; could alternatively be unclear. ONC201: no INN stated in record, kept as development code. Two experimental arms, no control.
